name: uv__tls_key

ownership.argument: The pthread key libuv allocates for its own TLS block. Reading this word and then indexing the task-info array gives the 808-byte block that holds the default loop pointer at +760.

provenance.source: Exact .036 producer and global initialization, recorded in p67-036-native-contract.md.

notes: A 4-byte RAM global; it holds the key value, not a pointer to the block.
